units: Two quiet existing SwiGLU neurons per relation/subtoken key, chosen by their measured contribution magnitude over calibration states.
formula: d=dual of native normalized input keys after removing protected principal subspace; c=mean key / squared norm; gate_a=beta*(d-threshold*c); gate_b=beta*(d-(threshold+width)*c); up_a=up_b=c; down_a=-down_b=gain*value/(beta*width).
threshold_rule: Normalize d.x by c.x. Place bounded activation interval between maximum observed non-target score and minimum target score. Skip keys lacking positive separation. No parameter search or loss.
reason: Linear edits changed words before the factual decision. Bounded activation must remain near zero on those earlier states and saturate at the native factual relation.
